counterparts_needing_dossiers.name: Lutici (Liutizian federation of the Elbe-Oder Slavs)

problems: Cliopatria's 'Holy Roman Empire' (962..1259) and 'Holy Roman Empire Minor States' (1260..1806) share Wikidata Q12548 and are one empire; this dossier covers only the first row and ends at 1259 with a confidence-1 dissolve event that is a row boundary (successor holy-roman-empire-minor-states, eu-09). The colour agent should give both the same colour; the dossier's end/dissolve is not a collapse.

The row's stray 1619..1621 shape (604 cells in Bohemia, Moravia, Silesia and Lusatia) is the Bohemian Crown lands, not the Empire; verdict wrong, correction: use the Minor States shape for the Empire in 1619-1621. The Kingdom of Bohemia/Habsburg owners should decide who gets the fragment.
Cliopatria draws northern Italy twice in 962-969 (Kingdom of Italy row 623 of 657 cells inside this shape) and Corsica under the Pisa row in 1139-1146.

Eight existing shapes are adjusted for years or status and six new keyframes are added (983, 1157, 1164, 1185, 1198, 1227); the kingdom-of-germany and kingdom-of-arles dossiers (eu-08-a) were not touched.
The validator warns that counterpart 'lutici' (4 events) has no dossier; the Lutici need one (counterparts_needing_dossiers).
The Henry the Lion page was thin for borders (no Niklot, 1160, Verchen); the Duchy of Pomerania page carried the Pomeranian dates instead.
